decisions.reason: The multi-model bleaching tray line had its own page and fits the core dental thermoforming range, so management would read any soft results as temporary and persist.
The PETG blank is a low-cost, visibly presented addition to the established thermoforming portfolio, and there is little reason to withdraw it.
The UV-curing lacquer carries lower public commitment, but it is an inexpensive consumable supporting the announced digital workflow, so keeping it is likely.
The contrast spray supports intraoral scanning, which is central to the firm's announced digital manufacturing direction, and that justifies continued commitment.
Custom earmolds belong to the firm's core custom-device base, though the earlier withdrawal of the hearing protection line shows some willingness to prune in the hearing segment.
